source: Copied by hand from a real route card in the app: the screenshot route-result-detour-day (public/img/screens/route-result-detour-day-*), captured 2026/09/25 at 09:04 SAST with live traffic. Grades, times, distances, area counts, the percentage and the differences are exactly as the card shows them (the card's +9.8 km comes from unrounded distances, so it is copied, not worked out). The app labels the first option Standard, not Fastest, because that morning the lower-risk route was the quicker one. No place names are recorded here on purpose: the high-risk areas this trip avoids are in named suburbs, and the site never lets a reader connect a suburb to risk. Every page string that shows these figures reads this file.
